subject.title: [Bug]: openai-completions fallback candidate is selected, but fallback does not complete successfully through an OpenAI-compatible proxy

question: Should OpenClaw wait for a redacted proxy capture before choosing between another sanitizer, better fallback diagnostics, or a strict-minimal completions mode for this provider class?
rationale: Current source proves the real agent payload is broader than the reporter's direct POST, but the exact failing field or response is still unknown and adding broad config surface would affect provider compatibility policy.

options.title: Request proxy capture first
options.body: Ask for the failed OpenClaw outbound request body plus proxy status/body, then choose the smallest sanitizer, diagnostic, or docs update from concrete evidence.

options.title: Approve a strict-minimal mode design
options.body: Treat narrow OpenAI-compatible proxy support as a new product/config surface and design the compatibility contract before implementation.

options.title: Limit this to diagnostics
options.body: Improve fallback logging or documentation without changing request shape until a concrete incompatible field is proven.

recommendation.title: Request proxy capture first
recommendation.body: Ask for the failed OpenClaw outbound request body plus proxy status/body, then choose the smallest sanitizer, diagnostic, or docs update from concrete evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is already assigned to osolmaz and the remaining choice is provider fallback product direction rather than a purely mechanical fix.
